>> Tyra: PREVIOUSLY
ON "AMERICA'S NEXT TOP MODEL,"

THE HARSH REALITY
OF THE MODELING WORLD

OVERWHELMED CATIE
AND SPARKED A RIVALRY
BETWEEN YOANNA AND CAMILLE...

TO SAY TO YOU,
I WILL SAY IT TO YOUR FACE.

HER FATHER'S DISAPPROVAL.

PROSTITUTION.

>> Tyra: AND IN
THE LAST ELIMINATION,
XIOMARA WAS SENT HOME.
SEVEN GIRLS REMAIN.

WHO WILL BE
ELIMINATED TONIGHT?

WHEN IT WAS YOU

AND XIOMARA UP THERE,
DID YOU THINK

SHE WAS GOING HOME,
OR YOU WERE GOING HOME?

Camille: I'M NOT--
I WASN'T GOING HOME.
I WAS JUST CHILLING.
I WASN'T NERVOUS.

Tyra: CAMILLE,
CONGRATULATIONS.

Catie: CAMILLE IS
AN INCREDIBLY STRONG WOMAN.

SHE HAS NO VULNERABILITY
AND SHOWS NO EMOTIONS,
HAPPY NOR SAD.
SHE'S ALWAYS JUST MEDIUM.

BE HONEST--
WHAT ONE DID YOU LIKE BETTER,
LONG HAIR OR SHORT HAIR?

Camille: I THINK
THAT WITH YOUR SHORT HAIR,

YOU CAN DO SOME
FUNKY THINGS WITH IT.
YOU JUST HAVE TO PLAY WITH IT.

Catie: WELL,
WHAT MY PROBLEM IS

IS I'M TRYING TO CHANGE WHO I AM
FOR THE JUDGES TO LIKE ME.
I THINK IT REALLY SUCKS.
Camille: SALUD!
SALUD.
Sara: SALUD.

Mercedes: OH,
MINE'S WAY BIGGER.
April: MINE'S WAY BIGGER.

Mercedes: NO, MINE ACTUALLY
GOES OVER MY STOMACH.
April: THAT'S A BELLY!

Mercedes: MY BELLY
SURPASSES YOURS.
April: SIX-PACK--GONE.

Mercedes: IT LOOKS
LIKE I'M 2 POUNDS.
Catie: EW!

CAMILLE PUTS KETCHUP
ON HER PICKLES.
April: THAT'S OKAY.

DON'T SAY, "EW!"
WHEN PEOPLE DO STUFF.
Yoanna: WE DON'T GO, "EW!"

WHEN YOU'RE EATING
YOUR HAMBURGERS.

Catie: I WAS JUST SAYING--
I DIDN'T MEAN IT IN A RUDE WAY.
I WAS JUST SAYING, YOU KNOW...

NO, BUT YOU GUYS
DO IT TO ME A LOT.
Mercedes: CATIE--

SHE'S GETTING
TOO SENSITIVE FOR ME.
IT'S JUST, LIKE, "SHUT UP!
SHUT UP! SHUT UP! SHUT UP!"

Catie: IT WAS
SUPPOSED TO BE A JOKE.

Yoanna: GUYS,
THERE'S TYRA MAIL!

"THE WORLD IS FULL OF COLOR,
BUT SOMETIMES IT'S SEEN BEST
IN BLACK AND WHITE."

WE HAVE TO PREPARE FOR A
BLACK-AND-WHITE PHOTO SHOOT,
WHICH I THOUGHT IS SO GREAT.
CLASSIC! GET READY.
Shandi: RIGHT NOW!
RIGHT NOW!

Camille: I WOKE UP
THIS MORNING, AND I DON'T KNOW

WHAT'S GOING ON, BUT MY MOUTH
WAS LIKE SUPER, SUPER-SWOLLEN,
AND IT HURT.

IT'S JUST GETTING WORSE,
LIKE IT'S JUST GETTING TIGHTER.

LIKE,
IT'S HARDER FOR ME TO TALK,
'CAUSE IT'S IN THE CORNERS.

April: IS IT THIS WHOLE AREA,
OR JUST ISOLATED?
Camille: EVERYTHING.

Mercedes: CAMILLE
IS HAVING FAT LIPS,

AND SHE HAS, LIKE, AN ALLERGIC
REACTION TO SOMETHING.

SHE'S PROBABLY
FEELING SELF-CONSCIOUS.

Camille: BUT IT JUST, LIKE--
I DON'T HAVE BIG LIPS,
BUT IT'S JUST BIGGER.
I FEEL IT.

AND YOU'RE GONNA SEE IT
IN THE PICTURES.
Jay: GOOD MORNING.

TODAY IS A BIT OF A CHALLENGE,
'CAUSE WHAT WE'RE GONNA DO
ARE BEAUTY SHOTS.

THE CAMERA IS RIGHT IN HERE,
AND IT'S ALL ABOUT EMOTING
WITH YOUR EYES.

TODAY'S PHOTOGRAPHER
IS BILL HEUBERGER, AND HE IS
A NOTED FASHION PHOTOGRAPHER.
HE'S EVEN SHOT TYRA BANKS.

Bill: IT'S WHAT'S INSIDE
THAT'S GONNA MAKE YOU PRETTY,

AND IF WE CAN CAPTURE THAT,
THEN WE'RE DOING WELL.

Jay: NOW I KNOW, CAMILLE,
YOU HAD AN ISSUE

'CAUSE YOU FEEL
LIKE YOU'RE HAVING
AN ALLERGIC REACTION TODAY.

Camille: I DON'T KNOW
WHAT THE ORDER IS,

BUT IF I COULD JUST, LIKE,
HANG OUT FOR A MINUTE,

MAYBE THE SWELLING AND STUFF
WILL GO DOWN, YOU KNOW?

Jay: WE CAN HAVE YOU
GO LAST TODAY.

Camille: OKAY.
Jay: SO LET'S GET GOING.

TECHNICALLY, A BEAUTY SHOOT IS
THE MOST DIFFICULT SHOOT TO DO.

IF YOU'RE NOT CONFIDENT,
IT'LL DEFINITELY READ
IN THE FINAL PHOTOGRAPH.

SO I THINK THE GIRLS TODAY,
IT'S KIND OF, LIKE,
THE BIGGEST CHALLENGE FOR THEM.

Mercedes: THE PHOTOGRAPHER
KEPT GOING LIKE THIS...
(making clicking sounds)
LIKE, WHEN HE TOOK THE PICTURE.

HE KIND OF THREW ME OFF,
'CAUSE I STARTED SMILING,

AND IT'S SUPPOSED TO BE,
LIKE, SERIOUS AND SENSUAL.
Bill: (clicking)

April: SEE, I WANT TO CONVEY,
LIKE, A TONE, ESPECIALLY 'CAUSE

I NEED ALL THE OPPORTUNITIES
TO CONVEY SOME KIND

OF PERSONALITY THAT I CAN,
YOU KNOW WHAT I MEAN?

LIKE, IF THEY SEE IT
IN A PHOTOGRAPH.

THEY HURT MY FEELINGS
SO MUCH YESTERDAY.
Mercedes: OH, THEY DID?

April: SOMEHOW THE JUDGES,
LIKE, DON'T LIKE ME, YOU KNOW?
Mercedes: OH, GOD.

April: LINGERING THAT MORNING
WAS THE COMMENT THAT,

"YOU HAD THE BEST PICTURE,
BUT THE JUDGES DON'T LIKE YOU."

Tyra: WHEN YOU TALK,
AND HOW YOU'RE MOVING YOUR HANDS

SO LIKE THIS,
IT'S NOT A LIKEABLE, WARM PERSON

THAT I REALLY WANT
TO GET TO KNOW BETTER,

AND I KNOW THAT'S INSIDE OF YOU,
AND I WANT THEM TO SEE
THAT BEAUTIFUL PART OF YOU.

Mercedes: YOUR THING JUST
DIDN'T PARTICULARLY GO WELL,

BUT THEY DIDN'T
TOTALLY REAM YOU EITHER.
April: I KNOW.
I'M SO SENSITIVE. I KNOW.
Mercedes: YOU ARE.
IT'S WHAT THEY REMEMBER.
YOU KNOW WHAT I MEAN?
April: IT'S PERSONALITY, TOO.

Mercedes: BUT YOU HAVE
A PERSONALITY.
IT'S NOT LIKE YOU'RE A DRONE.

APRIL--I LOVE HER,
BUT SHE'S GONNA DIE

OF A HEART ATTACK
BEFORE SHE HITS 27,

BECAUSE SHE JUST PUTS
SO MUCH STRESS ON, LIKE,

THE LITTLE THINGS
AND DOESN'T LISTEN
TO THE POSITIVE THINGS.
Bill: OPEN YOUR EYES.

April: MY BIGGEST FEAR IS
THAT I WILL LEAVE

THIS COMPETITION AND BE TOLD,
"YOU KNOW WHAT, APRIL?

YOU GAVE US
FLAWLESS PHOTOGRAPHS,

BUT YOU DIDN'T STEP IT UP
A NOTCH AND BRING YOU OUT,

'CAUSE TO ME, THAT'S ALMOST LIKE
IMPLYING THAT I WAS AFRAID
TO DO THAT, AND I'M NOT AFRAID.

Catie: I'M GONNA LOOK BEST
WHEN I FEEL COMFORTABLE
WITH WHO I'M BEING.

SO I'M GONNA GO EXACTLY BACK
TO MY PLAIN JANE LOOK AND BE ME.

THEY CAN CRITICIZE ME
EVERY WEEK IF THEY WANT TO,

BUT AT LEAST I'LL BE
COMFORTABLE.

Camille: MY MOUTH WAS, LIKE,
SUPER, SUPER SWOLLEN
AND IT HURT.

Jay: ACTUALLY,
IT'S NOT THAT BAD.
WE CAN TAKE IT DOWN.

SOMETIMES, YOU KNOW, AS MODELS,
YOU NEED TO SHOW UP
IN WHATEVER THE CONDITIONS.
YOU JUST GOTTA GO.
YOU KNOW, THAT KIND OF THING.

Camille: JAY TOLD ME THAT
WHEN I'M IN FRONT OF THE CAMERA,

I HAVE TO PRETEND LIKE I DON'T
HAVE THIS PROBLEM RIGHT NOW.

Jay: GIVE IT TO ME
IN YOUR EYES.
GIVE IT TO ME IN YOUR ENERGY.
OKAY?
ALL RIGHT, GOOD. LET'S GO.

Bill: JUST LOOK
RIGHT AT THE CAMERA.
NICE AND RELAXED.

Jay: JUST ALWAYS GIVE ME,
YOU KNOW, KIND OF PRETTY EYE,
SOFT EXPRESSION.
YOU KNOW WHAT I MEAN?

OTHERWISE, IT LOOKS
A LITTLE HARD.

YOU HAVE TO KNOW HOW
TO TURN IT ON AND OFF,

NO MATTER HOW TIRED YOU ARE,
NO MATTER HOW MUCH PAIN
YOU'RE IN.
YOU JUST HAVE TO DO IT.

I THINK CAMILLE GAVE IT
A GOOD SHOT.
DID CAMILLE GIVE 100%?
I DON'T THINK SO.
Bill: BINGO.
THANK YOU VERY MUCH.

Camille: I WANNA SEE
THAT THING, 'CAUSE I THINK
I DID REALLY WELL.

Jay: HEY, GIRLS,
THIS IS KYLE HAGLER,
A MANAGER OVER AT IMG.
YOU KNOW, TYRA'S WITH IMG.

Mercedes: THIS IS HUGE,
BECAUSE HE'S GONNA BE MANAGING
THE WINNER.

Kyle: IN THIS FIELD
THAT IS EVER-SO-CHANGING,

YOU'RE SEEING A LOT MORE
ACTRESSES

ON THE COVERS OF MAGAZINES AS
OPPOSED TO MODELS.

THE MODEL/ACTRESS--
SHE'S LIKE A DOUBLE THREAT,

BECAUSE SHE'S ABLE TO PROJECT
A FEELING.

SO TODAY YOU GUYS ARE GOING OFF
TO AN ACTING CLASS.
Yoanna: COOL.

Sara: I'M NERVOUS
ABOUT THE ACTING CLASS.

A LOT OF US HAVE NEVER GONE
ONSTAGE BEFORE.

Kyle: IT'S IMPORTANT
THAT YOU GUYS ALL UNDERSTAND

THAT THE TWO WORLDS WORK
SIDE BY SIDE.
April: I LOVE ACTING CLASS.

Camille: MY MOUTH RIGHT NOW
IS, LIKE...

Mercedes: IT'S NOT THAT BAD,
ACTUALLY.
LET ME SEE.
Camille: I CAN STILL FEEL IT.

Mercedes: I JUST CAN'T
REMEMBER HOW BIG YOUR LIPS WERE
TO BEGIN WITH.

Yoanna: CAMILLE IS LIKE
DRAMA, DRAMA, DRAMA, DRAMA.

HER LIPS WERE PUFFED UP,
SO SHE NEEDED SOME MEDICINE,

I GUESS, TO BRING DOWN
THE SWELLING.

Camille: I DON'T WANNA
MISS OUT ON THE ACTIVITY

FOR THE DAY,
BUT MY HEALTH COMES FIRST.
Tyra: HELLO, EVERYBODY.
CAMILLE? IS SHE COMIN'?

Catie: HER WHOLE MOUTH
IS SWOLLEN AND, LIKE,
IT'S MOVING BACK HERE.

Tyra: OH,
SHE'S AT THE DOCTOR?

Catie: YEAH.
Tyra: OH, OKAY.

I HAVE A VERY SPECIAL PERSON
HERE.

SHE'S ONE
OF MY VERY BEST FRIENDS.
HER NAME IS TASHA SMITH-ARQESE.
SHE IS AN AMAZING ACTRESS.

THE TOP MODELS IN THE WORLD
KNOW HOW TO ACT.

Tasha: YOU NEED SOMETHING
GOING ON ON THE INSIDE

IN ORDER TO LOOK IN THAT CAMERA
AND MAKE PEOPLE WANT YOU
TO SELL THEIR PRODUCT.

Tyra: I'VE DONE EXERCISES
WITH TASHA WHERE I'M CRYIN'

AND SCREAMIN' AND DON'T KNOW
HOW SHE GOT THAT OUT OF ME.

THAT ONLY MAKES ME
A BETTER MODEL, AND IT MAKES ME
A BETTER ACTRESS.

Tasha: SO, TYRA?
Tyra: BYE, Y'ALL!
BYE, MISS TASHA.

Tasha: THANK YOU, SISTA!
MWAH!
BYE, YOU GUYS.

Tasha: AND NOW YOU'RE ALL
IN MY HANDS.

Sara: WHEN TYRA LEAVES,
IT'S A WHOLE OTHER BALL GAME.

SHE'S LIKE,
"OKAY, WE'RE GONNA GET DIRTY."

Tasha: WHAT MAKES US
REALLY GOOD ACTORS

IS THAT WE'RE ABLE TO LOCATE
EACH INDIVIDUAL EMOTIONAL THING
AND UTILIZE IT AS A TOOL.

SO TODAY WHAT I WANNA REALLY
TRY TO WORK ON IS BEING OPEN
AND BEING HONEST.

I'M JUST GONNA GIVE YOU GUYS
THIS PIECE OF PAPER, OKAY?

AND LET'S JUST TALK ABOUT
REJECTION, BECAUSE THAT'S WHAT

SOME OF YOU ARE GONNA HAVE
TO DEAL WITH--REJECTION.
YOU KNOW HOW IT FEELS?

HOW MANY OF YOU HAVE EVER HAD
A BOYFRIEND THAT BROKE UP
WITH YOU?
A DADDY THAT LEFT YOU?

IMAGINE THAT IS
A "DEAR JOHN" LETTER

FROM WHOEVER THAT PERSON IS
THAT YOU FELT REJECTED YOU
AND LEFT YOU.
LOOK AT IT.

YOU SEE THE EMOTIONS
THAT'S COMING UP?

Sara: IT'S, LIKE, WEIRD
BECAUSE YOU'RE LOOKIN' AT

A BLANK PIECE OF PAPER,
BUT IT HAS SO MUCH ON IT.

April: EMOTIONS, TO ME,
ARE UNCONTROLLABLE.

WHEN I OPEN MYSELF UP TO THEM,
THERE ARE TEARS IMMEDIATELY,
AND IT'S, LIKE... (sighs)
Tasha: LOOK AT IT.

NOW I WANT YOU TO RIP
THAT PIECE OF PAPER UP
IN LITTLE TEENY PIECES.
RIP IT UP! RIP IT UP! RIP IT UP!
STOP!

NOW ALL OF YOU RIGHT NOW
ARE HURTING.

ALL OF YOU RIGHT NOW
MAY BE FEELING ANGER,
HURT, PAIN.

DON'T FORGET WHAT YOU'RE FEELING
RIGHT NOW, BECAUSE YOU'RE GONNA
HAVE OPPORTUNITIES TO USE THIS.

IF YOU'RE WORKING TO TRY
TO ACCOMPLISH A CAREER
AS AN ACTOR-- HELLO.

Camille: HI. HOW ARE YOU?
Tasha: SO WE HAVE
A NEW PERSON COMING IN.
WHAT'S YOUR NAME?

Camille: CAMILLE.
Tasha: HI, CAMILLE.

Camille: I'M SLOWLY LOOKING
AT EVERYONE'S FACES,

REALIZING THAT PEOPLE ARE KIND
OF SAD AND CRYING AND QUIET.

SO I'M JUST LIKE,
OH... MY... GOD.

Tasha: WHAT IS IT
THAT YOU'RE FEELING RIGHT NOW?

LIKE, WHAT'S THE THING THAT
MADE YOU BREAK DOWN AND CRY?
Sara: MY DAD.

MY FATHER JUST HAS THIS MINDSET
THAT MODELING IS NOT THE JOB
FOR A DAUGHTER.

Tasha: I NEED YOU
TO LOOK AT HER

AND SAY TO YOUR FATHER
EVERYTHING THAT YOU'VE WANTED
TO SAY ABOUT HOW HE'S HURT YOU.

I WANT YOU TO REPEAT EVERYTHING
THAT SHE SAYS QUIETLY, OKAY?
BEGIN TO TALK.

Sara: I'M DOING THIS,
BUT IF YOU DISOWN ME--
I'M GONNA BE A MODEL.

Mercedes: I'M GONNA BE
A MODEL.
Sara: YOU CAN HATE ME.

Mercedes: YOU CAN DO
WHATEVER YOU WANNA DO...

Sara: IT'S KIND OF LIKE
AN OUT-OF-BODY EXPERIENCE,

AND I'M FEELING JUST THIS ENERGY
AROUND US.

Shandi: I DON'T KNOW ANYONE
IN MY FAMILY BECAUSE OF YOU.
I HATE YOU.

Catie: AND THERE WERE TIMES
I DID NOT WANNA LIVE BECAUSE
OF YOUR (bleep) FACE.
April: YOUR (bleep) FACE.

Mercedes: I DIDN'T THINK
WE WERE GONNA GET THIS HEAVY

BUT THIS WHOLE LESSON

WAS TO TEACH YOU
TO BE HONEST AND VULNERABLE.

April: I'M SO TIRED...
Catie: I'M SO TIRED.

Catie: OF BEING BRAVE...

April: OR FOR...

EMOTIONS IN OUR PERSONAL LIVES

Sara: (sobbing)

ARE YOU ANGRY AT ANYBODY?

Camille: I THINK...

SO YOU HAVE TO REPEAT HER.

TARNISHING MY CHARACTER.

IT HURT BECAUSE...
Yoanna: IT HURT BECAUSE...

TO JUST BE HONEST.

Camille: IT HURT BECAUSE
Yoanna: BECAUSE...

A NEW ENVIRONMENT
WITH NEW PEOPLE,

YOU'RE SUCKING RIGHT NOW!

THAT SHE WOULD HAVE IT OUT

WITH ME AND JUST SAY WHATEVER
SHE FELT REPRESSED,

AND THAT WAY, WE COULD JUST
KIND OF HATCHET IT
AND GET ON AND BE ADULTS.

YOU'RE STILL ON THE SURFACE.

THERE'S STUFF INSIDE YOUR HEART

REFUSE TO LET OUT.
Camille: I'M TRYING HERE.

I'M TRYING!
Tasha: I JUST--I DO.

THIS PERFECT MASK ON.

Camille: IT HAS TO DO
WITH ME, INSIDE OF ME.

IN YOUR CAREER,
BUT YOU'RE JUST BORING.

INTO THIS NEW SITUATION NOW,
MISSED THE FIRST HALF

MY MOUTH IS THE SIZE

OKAY.

HAVE A TEST.

FIGURE OUT THIS SCENE.

MAKE IT REAL
AND MAKE IT EFFECTIVE
THE WAY YOU AFFECTED EACH OTHER.

AFFECTED BY WAS CAMILLE.

Camille: I KNOW
IT'S A COMPETITION,

AND WE HAVE TO DO THIS
IN ORDER TO WIN,

AND SO WE HAVE TO GET
INTO THIS ACTING ROLE.

IT'S JUST GONNA BE
VERY DIFFICULT.
THAT JUST MIGHT BE MY DOWNFALL.

REALLY EMOTIONALLY DRAINED.

EMOTIONAL?

GO THERE.

WITH SOMEBODY ELSE?

FOR YOU.

SO I DON'T HAVE TO TASTE
ANY OF YOU OTHER HOS.
Shandi: EW!

SAY THAT?
NO PERSON WOULD SAY THAT.

(dramatic voice) "I REMEMBER
YOUR FUNERAL
LIKE IT WAS YESTERDAY."

(normal voice) YOU WOULD SAY,
"I REMEMBER

SHE'S LIKE A MACHINE.

UNDERSTAND NOW HOW

TO WORK THROUGH THIS SCRIPT.

I NEED TO JUST COME IN
THROUGH THE DOOR SWINGING

Catie: HERE,
I'LL PRACTICE WITH YOU.

PRACTICING, LIKE, THE LINES.

THE EMOTIONS.

WHO'S GONNA WIN

WHEN THEY TOLD ME,

WHEN THEY TOLD ME THAT

TO SLEEP EVERY NIGHT

LAURA, STRONG AND PROUD,

THE ONE THAT YOU LOVED
AND RESPECTED.
